Reproducibility checker constructs signed integral fundamental-cycle actions and passes all 11820 elements of \(S_n\times C_2\) for \(3\le n\le7\); finite tests do not replace the general proof.

value.rationale: The full infinite-valence arm-and-particle symmetry module is a natural topological invariant for the two-robot graph configuration problem. It distinguishes the indistinguishable-particle sector \(\bigwedge^2 V_n\) of the standard representation from the complementary label-sensitive \(S^{(n-2,2)}\) sector, gives a canonical integral cycle lattice and resolves all conjugacy classes simultaneously. This structural irreducible classification is information absent from known ranks and unordered barcodes. A graph model is known, so novelty/value reside in its full signed symmetry action, not the graph reduction or re-enumeration.
